Application Materials.content:
- Complete set of supporting documents (must be legible) have to be uploaded via the application portal. Do not send paper copies. Late submission will not be accepted. The School may contact applicants for additional information or documents at a later date (if required).
- You must upload electronic copies of your supporting documents to the application portal. Documents uploaded must be in English. Otherwise, they must be accompanied by certified translations in English language.
- If you are an existing final year undergraduate, you may apply for admission with provisional degree certificate and / or yearly examination results to date.
General Information on Supporting Documents:
1. Passport/Identification card (NRIC): Singapore Permanent Resident (SPR) has to upload NRIC and Re-entry permit; a copy of the personal particulars page of your passport or identification card.
2. One recent passport-sized colour photograph: image showing full face must be taken within the last 3 months; photograph must be in colour and taken against a white background.
3. Valid TOEFL/IELTS/GRE/GMAT Scores.
4. Degree Certification and Official Transcripts (Bachelor and/ or Masters):
- Degree Certificate: Original Language; Official translation in English (if original is not in English).
- Official Transcripts: Original Language; Official translation in English (if original is not in English); Grading or marking scale of the Transcript (Interpretation of Grades/Marks).
- Translation can be done by the Home University or any official authorized parties.
5. Note on Official Transcripts:
- A copy of official transcript with detailed academic results (marks obtained in each subject, not just grades obtained, wherever possible) is required from each university attended. It should show the university name with the official stamp or it should be certified and translated by the university.
- If the transcript is in a language other than English, please provide an official English translation as well and the subjects in the translation should be listed in the same order as that of the original transcript (label the transcript if need be).
- The applicant is responsible for requesting transcripts from his/her university or universities.
6. Expected Graduation Certificate (if applicable): Applicants who have not yet graduated must submit an official document from their university indicating their expected graduation date. Applicants must ensure that the expected graduation date allows completion of their current degree before the commencement of the intended semester/trimester intake.
7. Other Supporting documents (if applicable): Resume.

Interview Requirements.content: Applicants without TOEFL/IELTS would still be eligible to apply, but they may be subjected to an interview/test if deemed necessary by the School.

Academic Requirements.content:
- **A good Bachelor's Degree** in a quantitative discipline (mathematics, statistics, engineering, computer science etc.) is preferred.
- Preferred but **not required**: some relevant work experience.
- The criteria listed above are minimum admission requirements. **Meeting these criteria does not guarantee admission, as selection is competitive.**

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
Below are **preferred but _not required_**:
- A good GMAT score or GRE score
Applicants may upload their TOEFL, IELTS, GMAT or GRE score via the online application.

Program Overview.content:
[**The Master of Science (MSc) in Analytics**](https://www.ntu.edu.sg/spms/about-us/mathematics/grad/msc-in-analytics) programme is an interdisciplinary post-graduate programme suitable for professionals seeking to leverage business analytics in their respective fields, as well as recent college graduates pursuing a career in the data science industry. Analytics is the science of finding patterns in data to aid decision making. It is an interdisciplinary field rooted in applied mathematics, with a wide range of applications in business, finance, and industry. The MSc in Analytics programme provides the skills and knowledge for applying cutting-edge data science techniques to business challenges in the modern economy. [MSc in Analytics Brochure](https://wcms-prod-admin.ntu.edu.sg/docs/librariesprovider123/graduate/msc-programmes/ntu-spms-brochure_msa_2026.pdf?sfvrsn=32df954e_3/%20NTU-SPMS-Brochure_MSA_2026)
The MSc in Analytics programme is an intensive **one-year full-time or two-year part-time** programme by coursework taught in three trimesters. Upon completion of the study, students are awarded a Master of Science (MSc) in Analytics degree. The programme consists of a total of **30 Academic Units (AU)**, with **18 AU** stemming from core courses and **12 AU** from elective courses. The curriculum includes core courses, elective courses, **1 Analytics Practicum Course (self-sourced internship)**, ad-hoc seminars on analytics software tools, and ad-hoc seminars from industry professionals.
The curriculum strongly emphasises the application of analytics on real-world data and includes one practicum, elective course of 6 AU. Full-time students had internships in organisations for the practicum course, including APL, BreadTalk, Charles & Keith, DHL, Experian, Grab, UPS, Shopee, Lazada, DBS, UOB, Johnson & Johnson, JR Group, Lenovo, MSD, PSA, and PwC.
On average, full-time students take **4-5** classes a week, and part-time students take **2-3** classes a week. For academic enquiries, email the Programme Director, Dr Lim Kay Jin ([limkj@ntu.edu.sg](mailto:limkj@ntu.edu.sg)).

The curriculum strongly emphasises the application of analytics on real-world data and includes one practicum, elective course of 6 AU. The requirements for graduation are:
- Successful completion of all requirements as prescribed by the programme of study; and
- Attainment of a minimum CGPA of 2.50 at the completion of the programme of study.

Financial Aid.content:
7. The university currently has no scholarship, government service agreement, or service obligation scheme available for students.
**Scholarships:**
- **_(Singapore Citizens only)_** The **Singapore Digital (SG:D) Scholarship** is offered by the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA). The terms and conditions of the scholarship have been enhanced to groom aspiring Infocomm Media (ICM) talent to be industry-ready for an exciting career in a fast-evolving digital economy. [Click here for more information about the scholarship](https://www.imda.gov.sg/how-we-can-help/singapore-digital-scholarship/postgraduate#:~:text=The%20SG%20Digital%20Scholarship%20%28Postgraduate%29%20is%20an%20industry,Cybersecurity%2C%20Analytics%2C%20Immersive%20Media%2C%20and%20Digital%20Content%20Creation.).
**SPMS MSc Studentship:** SPMS awards studentships to outstanding candidates to nurture talents for the competitive quantitative field. Studentship applicants must possess vital/strong academic records and demonstrate leadership qualities and potential. This studentship is open to candidates of all nationalities **except** those already receiving a scholarship. All applicants will be considered for the awards, and the shortlisted candidates will receive interview invitations. The successful candidates will receive a studentship letter together with the offer letter.
**Financial Assistance:**
- **_Singapore Citizens (SCs):_** enjoy a study grant of S$10,000 + prevailing GST (S$10,900).
- **_Singapore Permanent Residents (SPRs):_** enjoy a study grant of S$5,000 + prevailing GST (S$5,450).
- **_Needy SCs and SPRs_** may apply for financial aid (up to S$10,900 in addition to the SC/SPR study grant).
- **_NTU Alumni_** _:_ On top of the above, alumni can enjoy a 10% grant of the tuition fee. Eligible for holders of bachelor’s, master’s, and/or doctoral degrees obtained from NTU Singapore.
- **_SCs and SPRs_** may enjoy tuition fee subsidies under SkillsFuture Singapore **(For enquiry: sfcredit@ntu.edu.sg)**

Multiple Applications.content:
- Applicants have to use the same application number if applying for more than one programme in the same intake (i.e. August intake). For applications under different intake, please use a new application number.
- Application fee will be charged for each Coursework application. Application fee payment is non-transferable and non-refundable.

Deferral Admission Policy.content: Deferments are evaluated on a case-by-case basis and granted only under special circumstances. If you wish to defer, please reach out to your respective school for approval. NTU advises that you do not accept the offer at this time and instead re-apply for the programme of your interest when you are ready.

Conditional Admission Policy.content:
A conditional offer is extended to an applicant who is in the process of completing the final term, semester, or trimester of their current course of study, and has outstanding educational documents. This condition will be clearly outlined in the offer letter, stating: "The offer of admission is on condition that you obtain your Bachelor's degree with a ________ from ___________ , ___________ "
For **Conditional Offer** (i.e. subject to attaining a Bachelor/ Masters’ degree), you are required to upload your **Bachelor/ Masters’ degree scrolls and Official Transcript** (Original and English Language translated). If you are unable to upload your Bachelor/ Masters’ degree scroll during verification period, you are to upload **a letter of completion** from your university stating that you have completed and attained Bachelor/ Masters’ degree. **Do not complete e-verification if you do not meet the condition stated on the offer letter. Kindly contact your school for assistance.**
**International Student with International Qualification**:
- Official degree certificate and final transcript
- Digital copy of Student Pass (Full-time students) / Valid immigration pass (For Part-time students only)
- Degree verification report (English) from NTU approved credential verification agency **within one month of your term start date**
- Latest Passport (If not yet submitted)
**International Student with Local (Singapore) Qualification**:
- Official degree certificate and final transcript
- Digital copy of Student Pass (Full-time students) / Valid immigration pass (For Part-time students only)
- Degree verification screen capture from respective local university online degree verification portal
- Latest Passport (If not yet submitted)
